# 原生格式失败的完整证据与精确修补候选

此包无损保留 #4936 原提交 2d1137、实际 checkout a0cb0f3 / tree99a 的 repo-checks job127779715942 原失败。完整 log178,931B、MCP decoded原返回、29-job失败切点、0758增量18-run/29-job原API、两个源的原GET与完整pre/postimage、三段实际fmt输出、正反patch和完整两树、独立审阅均在34成员归档中。

候选只重排原formatter指定的三处空白；两文件合计不改任何非空白字节。独审实际7ea9cb737a8c57a215cbf473b2ad100c25ab668b接受该精确候选，全10802叶仅两叶变，候选tree c3e9ddc1799f470ac7c80e117ee953a7232847e0。此包本身不写生产ref，也不声明后继CI已经通过；原fmt exit1仍保留。

archive-manifest.json给完整34成员、XZ CRC64归档与11个ASCII base64分片的三重身份。先将所有分片按原相对路径恢复，再执行：

`python3 restore_evidence.py --root <本包目录> --output <不存在的新目录>`

只读解包全量核对每成员，然后运行归档内的独立Python/Git checker。没有Rust、rustfmt、Cargo、Bazel、产品测试、网络或远端ref操作。实际异目录恢复exit0/stderr0，独审6767B stdout与原f6d35f9逐字节相等。完整作者和独审freeze保留；临时partial Git object库不在归档中。

for row in f['files']:

    members['author/candidate/'+row['path']]=b
members['author/candidate/FREEZE.json']=(C/'FREEZE.json').read_bytes()

    members['ci-increment/'+name]=(E/name).read_bytes()
member_manifest={name:identity(b) for name,b in sorted(members.items())}
stream=io.BytesIO()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=stream,mode='w',format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as archive:
    for name,b in sorted(members.items()):
        info=tarfile.TarInfo(name);info.size=len(b);info.mode=0o644;info.mtime=0;info.uid=info.gid=0;info.uname=info.gname=''
        archive.addfile(info,io.BytesIO(b))
tarbytes=stream.getvalue()
packed=lzma.compress(tarbytes,format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ,check=lzma.CHECK_CRC64,preset=6)
(D/'evidence.original.tar.xz').write_bytes(packed)
partdir=D/'parts';partdir.mkdir()
encoded=base64.b64encode(packed)
parts=[]
for i,start in enumerate(range(0,len(encoded),60000)):
    b=encoded[start:start+60000]+b'\n';name=f'parts/archive.part-{i:03d}.base64.txt';(D/name).write_bytes(b)
    parts.append({'path':name,**identity(b)})
assert lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(b''.join((D/p['path']).read_bytes().strip() for p in parts),validate=True))==tarbytes
restored=D/'portable-restored';restored.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(packed),mode='r:xz') as archive:
    assert len(archive.getmembers())==len(members)
    for m in archive:
        assert m.isfile() and m.name in members
        b=archive.extractfile(m).read();assert b==members[m.name]
        p=restored/m.name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(restored/'independent/verify_candidate.py'),str(restored/'author/candidate')],
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=120)
(D/'portable-replay.stdout.json').write_bytes(run.stdout)
(D/'portable-replay.stderr.txt').write_bytes(run.stderr)
assert run.returncode==0 and not run.stderr and run.stdout==members['independent/replay-01.stdout.json']
manifest={'schema':'holdout-native-fmt-complete-evidence-archive-v1','archive':identity(packed),'tar':identity(tarbytes),
          'format':'tar.xz, lossless XZ CRC64; deterministic tar headers','member_count':len(members),
          'member_bytes':sum(len(b) for b in members.values()),'members':member_manifest,'parts':parts,
          'independent_review_actual_blob':'7ea9cb737a8c57a215cbf473b2ad100c25ab668b',
          'candidate_tree':'c3e9ddc1799f470ac7c80e117ee953a7232847e0',
          'original_failed_source':'a0cb0f33661e199674012e3302b0602407c91a8d',
          'original_job':127779715942,'original_job_conclusion':'failure',
          'portable_replay':{'exit':run.returncode,'stdout':identity(run.stdout),'stderr':identity(run.stderr),'all_stdout_bytes_equal':True},
          'qualification':'Only exact original formatter whitespace candidate accepted. No product/Rust/native/format success transferred.'}
dump(D/'archive-manifest.json',manifest)
dump(D/'PORTABLE_VERIFICATION.json',{'archive':identity(packed),'all_member_bytes_equal':True,'members':len(members),
    'all_original_author_and_independent_freeze_members_included':True,'independent_replay':manifest['portable_replay'],
    'no_Rust_native_CI_or_ref_operation':True})
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k not in ['members','parts']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

"""Restore retained evidence and replay its independent checker, with no product tools."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

def identity(b):
    return {'bytes':len(b),'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest(),
            'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--root',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    a=parser.parse_args();root=a.root.resolve();out=a.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    m=json.loads((root/'archive-manifest.json').read_bytes())
    encoded=[]
    for part in m['parts']:
        b=(root/part['path']).read_bytes()
        assert identity(b)=={k:part[k] for k in ['bytes','git_blob','sha256']}
        assert b.endswith(b'\n') and b.count(b'\n')==1
        encoded.append(b[:-1])
    packed=base64.b64decode(b''.join(encoded),validate=True)
    assert identity(packed)==m['archive']
    original=lzma.decompress(packed)
    assert identity(original)==m['tar']
    seen=set()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(original),mode='r:') as archive:
        for member in archive:
            path=PurePosixPath(member.name)
            assert member.isfile() and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
            assert member.name==str(path) and '\\' not in member.name and member.name not in seen
            seen.add(member.name)
            b=archive.extractfile(member).read()
            assert identity(b)==m['members'][member.name]
            p=out/'restored'/member.name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
    assert seen==set(m['members']) and len(seen)==m['member_count']
    result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(out/'restored/independent/verify_candidate.py'),str(out/'restored/author/candidate')],
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=120)
    (out/'independent.stdout.json').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (out/'independent.stderr.txt').write_bytes(result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr
    assert result.stdout==(out/'restored/independent/replay-01.stdout.json').read_bytes()
    proof={'schema':'holdout-fmt-evidence-portable-restoration-v1','archive':m['archive'],'members':len(seen),
           'all_member_hashes_and_bytes_equal':True,'independent_replay_exit':result.returncode,
           'independent_stdout':identity(result.stdout),'independent_stderr':identity(result.stderr),
           'independent_stdout_entire_bytes_equal':True,
           'scope':'Read retained bytes and local Git-only independent checker; no Rust/rustfmt/product/native/network/ref operation.'}
    (out/'RESTORATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
